Backfill posts one Issue per checkpoint-kind TaskItem folded from the event log (new TaskGraph().Fold(store.ReadAllEvents(runId)).Checkpoints()), carrying: title `<CheckpointId> — <Title>`; open/closed + `status:*` label from TaskItem.Status; `source:*` from TaskItem.Source; a `confirmed` label ONLY when TaskItem.Confirmed is true (the DONE ✓ distinction must survive the mirror); a stage Milestone from TaskItem.StageId; and a stable identity marker `<!-- conductor:task <taskId> -->` in the body.

Backfill posts a `run:<slug>` Issue carrying plan name, repo, branch and engine version (BuildInfo.Current), one comment per SessionFinished event (Number, StageId, Outcome, NewCommits, NewlyDone, CostUsd, Tokens*) and closes it when the run finished.

Idempotence: running the identical backfill a second time creates ZERO new issues and ZERO duplicate comments — upsert-never-clobber via a local map table plus marker search when the map is lost; an item whose declaration disappeared is retired with a label + closing comment, never deleted (WorkGraphSync semantics, verbatim in spirit).
